name: Hungry Crafter
description: Villagers and craftspeople get hungry: the moment it starts they say so in the game's own speech bubble, while hungry they greet with complaints instead of their cheerful lines, and once fed they thank you and greet as before. /hunger starve|feed [all] for the nearest NPC (or all). The server decides; players whose game runs Kiln see the bubbles, vanilla players keep the game's lines. Sample for docs/kiln/services/npc-speech.md (Kiln.Npcs), after Marshall's (Ryrin's) request.
